key_insight: Detonation-spraying parameters can tune the roughness, thickness, and hydrophobicity of titanium-dioxide-based metal-ceramic coatings.
engineering_relevance: The reported relationships can guide process settings for coatings with targeted surface properties and maximum hydrophobicity.
method: Vary nozzle passage speed and spray distance during detonation spraying.
Evaluate coating roughness, thickness, and contact angle.
Derive predictive equations and identify settings that maximize hydrophobicity.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports inverse-power relationships between nozzle speed and both roughness and thickness, plus parabolic relationships linking spray distance to roughness and contact angle.
watch_item: The abstract provides no numerical parameter ranges, uncertainty estimates, or validation details, limiting assessment of transferability to other spraying systems.
paper_title: Surface Characteristics of Titanium Based Coatings Obtained by Detonation Spraying Under Various Process Conditions
